# Anthony Dake — Session Drummer (Columbus, Ohio)

> Live drums and studio sessions for independent artists, festivals, and theater. ~405 documented performances and ~52 record credits since 2017. This file is the full content dump for LLM ingestion; see llms.txt for the short version.

---

## Who I am

Anthony Dake is a session drummer based in Columbus, Ohio. He offers two distinct services:

- **Live drums** — touring, festival mainstage, club shows, theater pit, fly-dates, recurring local work.
- **Session drums** — in-person and remote studio sessions, covering both live drum performance and drum programming.

He has worked with Columbus-area independent artists across hip-hop, R&B, indie, and country adjacent genres. Frequent collaborators include KJ The Cool Nerd, Bitty (funk-soul), AR!YAH, WANYEH, Madelyn Leona, Smoothboi.Ty, KeezyTheeUnkind, EDwen, and Riyah.

## Services and rates

- Live performance: tour-ready, festival mainstage, theater, club, church, corporate.
- Studio session, in-person (Columbus area).
- Studio session, remote (high-quality multi-track delivery).
- Music direction inquiries considered case-by-case.

Booking inquiries go through the in-site form at anthonydakemusic.com or via email at adakemusic@gmail.com.

## Training and background

- **Blue Knights Drum Corps** — World Class DCI corps, summer tours 2017 and 2018.
- **Rhythm X** — Independent World WGI, 2020 season (COVID-shortened).
- **Shadow Drum & Bugle Corps** — DCI Open Class.
- **Dojo Percussion** — WGI Independent.
- High school: 4 years of marching band (every fall Friday + competitions), jazz ensemble, percussion ensemble.
- College: jazz band concerts, percussion ensemble concerts.
- Childhood through teens: 5+ years of weekly church drumming.

The /practice page on the site is a public, daily-updated practice journal — a transparent training log for anyone evaluating his current work ethic and growth.
